## Runtime vs. Ratings

this is a short introduction to the analysis of the relationship between movie runtimes and ratings. 



@fig-runtime-ratings shows the relationship between movie runtimes and ratings.

::: {#cell-fig-runtime-ratings .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(df["runtime_min"], df["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDB Rating")
plt.show()
```
